title: Kiritani Haruka — Cheeky Junior!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Morning
Nonogi Park
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Exhale*
That's it for my run.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll stretch after taking a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I thought I'd be more fatigued after Idol Lovers, but that's surprisingly not the case.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If anything, this might be the best I've felt recently. Could it be because my body still remembers how I danced during the show...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Our appearance at Idol Lovers ended up going so well yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The audience went absolutely wild, and I could hear all their voices...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I wished that performance would never end...
I was having so much fun on stage that that was all I could think about.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And our incredible performance was made possible by...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Getting to perform alongside them really was huge.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They blew us all away the day at that joint rehearsal.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But when we were on stage together, they made it very clear that they also wanted to spread hope to others.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That allowed us to perform way above our usual level.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You can tell it's one of Mr. Hiiragi's groups...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And turn this moment where our hearts have become one into a really special memory!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Airi did such an amazing job yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I watched her make dramatic strides as we trained, but she absolutely soared during our performance...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I really wasn't expecting her to fly as high as she did.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That was the best performance I'd ever been a part of, and she made it happen.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No, not just me...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Shizuku and Minori also did really well yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (One person improved so much that everyone around them became better. As a result, we were able to reach a level that we normally can't.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which means, I...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I also need to get better.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to be able to do what Airi did yesterday. I want to bring out everyone's best.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to learn how to spread more and more hope to more and more people.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And to make that happen, for now, I need to keep practicing.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That settles that.
I think I'll keep running a bit more today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll also increase my sets for strength training—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A message?
Oh, it's from Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Message
rows.Line:
<Morning!
I'm looking at places where we can throw our Idol Lovers after-party right now. Anywhere you wanna go?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, our after-party...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Where should we go...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I really should just keep practicing like normal while sticking to my diet...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But breaks are also important.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Especially after putting on the show that we did.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Then, how about a buffet?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <One of my classmates told me about this new barbeque place that they said was really good.>

rows.Speaker: Airi's Message
rows.Line: <I'm down for all-you-can-eat barbeque!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'll have my cheat day coincide with our after-party.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Until then, I'll need to keep doing my best...!
se_run_women_001_2
